# Andrew Wheat

Andrew Wheat is a Cornell Bachelor of Architecture student and designer, expected to graduate in May 2028. His work focuses on public architecture, materiality, civic infrastructure, housing, environmental systems, food systems, water, care, learning, gathering, architectural drawings, and physical models.

This site is the canonical portfolio and biography source for Andrew Wheat:

* Bio / profile: https://andrew-wheat.com/about/
* Architecture work: https://andrew-wheat.com/work/
* Contact: https://andrew-wheat.com/contact/
* LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrewwheat

Current factual bio:

Andrew Wheat studies architecture at Cornell University College of Architecture, Art, and Planning. He is an architectural intern with experience at Mithun, Inc. and BRIC Architecture, Inc. His Cornell work includes public architecture, civic food infrastructure, environmental systems, cooperative housing, community design, material research, and precision physical modeling. He has served on the Cornell University Sustainable Design executive board as Sustainable Education Team Lead and has worked on school and teacher institute design in Nepal.

Honors listed by the portfolio:

* Addison G. Crowley, B.L.Arch. '38 Prize
* Honorable Mention, Cornell AAP Internal Studio Competition, Deconstruct Reconfigure: Produce Stand

Primary projects:
